rules.title: Prohibition on the Sale or Use of Coordinated Pricing Algorithms to Set Rents or Manage Occupancy Levels for Residential Dwelling Units
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to sell, license, or provide to Berkeley landlords any coordinated pricing algorithm that sets or recommends rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units. It is also unlawful for landlords to use such algorithms when setting rents or occupancy levels in Berkeley.
rules.summary_plain: Landlords in Berkeley cannot use or buy software that coordinates rent prices or occupancy levels with competitors to set rents for residential units.
rules.summary_plain_es: Los propietarios en Berkeley no pueden usar ni comprar software que coordine precios de alquiler o niveles de ocupación con competidores para fijar rentas de unidades residenciales.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley.
rules.exemptions_text: Does not apply to software that only publishes aggregated anonymous rental data, establishes rent or income limits per government affordable housing guidelines, or is used for market research, appraisal, or software development research/testing without using competitor data in live recommendations.
rules.penalty: Civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and each unit constituting a separate violation. Remedies include damages, injunctive relief, restitution, and attorney's fees.
rules.quoted_span: It shall be unlawful to sell, license, or otherwise provide to City of Berkeley landlords any coordinated pricing algorithm that sets or recommends rents or occupancy levels that may be achieved for residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley. It shall be unlawful for a landlord to use a coordinated pricing algorithm described in subsection A when setting rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley.
